name: Kenku
description: Age. Kenku have shorter lifespans than humans. They reach maturity at about 12 years old and can live to 60. Size. Kenku are around 5 feet tall and weigh between 90 and 120 pounds. Your size is Medium. Expert Forgery. You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects. Kenku Training. You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand. Mimicry. You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check. Languages. You can read and write Common and Auran, but you can only speak using your Mimicry trait.
